Vacancy for Cardiac Anaesthesiologist, Intensivist, CTVS O.T/ICU Technician, Perfusionist
Thursday, 13 June 2024
4019 Hits
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts with the prescribed proforma
(
download the form here
)
along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates for the said post which should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha – 442102, Maharashtra (email:
secretaryoffice@mgims.ac.in
) latest by 30/06/2024.
Cardiac Anaesthesiologist
Qualification
:
DM /DrNB/ FNB / DNB / PDCC / One-year accredited Certificate course in Cardiac Anesthesiology after MD Anaesthesiology or 3 years’ experience in Cardiac Anesthesia after MD Anesthesiology at a high volume cardiac set up.
SR ship after MD Anesthesiology (1 year) either as SR in a medical college or as a part of DM / DNB in a medical College - hospital with appropriate teaching certificate provided for the same.
Valid registration from medical council where practicing.
Experience
:
Experienced candidates will be given preference; however, freshers are also encouraged to apply.
Responsibility:
Primary - Cardiac Anesthesiology for Cardiothoracic surgery.
Additionally support to be provided to Cardiac surgery ICU to Cardiac surgeon.
Additionally, as appropriate roles and responsibilities of Anaesthesiologist to be fulfilled in a Medical College and teaching hospital.
Intensivist
Qualification
:
DM/ DrNB – CTVS Intensive Care / Intensive Care/Critical Care Medicine/ Pulmonary Medicine & Critical Care Medicine/ Cardiac Anaesthesia/Intensive Care
MD/DNB/FNB/PDCC – Anaesthesiology/ General Medicine/ Internal Medicine/ Emergency Medicine/ Anaesthesia & Critical Care/ Critical Care Medicine/ Cardiac Anaesthesia
SR ship after MD/DNB (1 year) must either as SR in a medical college
DM / DNB in a medical college - hospital with appropriate teaching certificate provided for   the same.
Valid registration from medical council where practicing.
Experience
Preferrable to have cardiac or CTVS or CCU experience to handle IABP, Defibrillators, Pacemaker, Emergency life support in coordination with cardiac surgery team
Experienced candidates will be given preference; however, freshers are also encouraged to apply.
Responsibility
Primary – CTVS ICU management along with Cardiothoracic surgeon
Additionally – Cath lab ICU for cardiac patients and other ICU management on cal
CTVS O.T/ICU Technician
Qualification:
Degree (BSc) /Diploma in o.t technology
Experience
– minimum 1 year in cardiac O.T
Role specifications
Preparation of O.T room for surgery – checking the instruments, table. Sterilization and infection Control
Blood arrangements, coordinating with team for drug arrangements and availability
Shifting in patient safely
Assistance to anesthesia team and surgeon team during surgery – should know technical details of all monitors and equipments used and troubleshoot any issues
Operating room management – organization, looking over cleaning
Patient monitoring
Documentation and record keeping
Safely shifting patient to ICU
Basic CTVS ICU assistance and equipment care
Perfusionist
Qualification
Degree in Perfusion Technology from a recognized University/Institution
Or Diploma in Perfusion Technology from a recognized Institution.
Experience
3-4 years of experience in conducting perfusion in a hospital independently, should be able to handle emergency and paediatric cases
Should be able to recognize technical problem and troubleshoot or communicate accordingly.
Preferable have experience with ECMO, Aortic procedures, DHCA.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age
: Between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Note:
Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate.
Society reserves the right related to selection or appointment.
No TA and DA will be paid by Kasturba Health Society for attending the interview.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
